title: Signal: Memcached statistics disclosed
scope: One response whose body is memcached statistics output.
limitations: One response body. The rule reports the statistics reply; it does not issue a get or set and cannot show which keys are stored.

observation.body:
STAT pid 1
STAT uptime 918273
STAT version 1.6.21
STAT curr_connections 12
STAT cmd_get 91823
STAT curr_items 4021
STAT bytes 1048576
END

STAT version 1.6.17
STAT uptime 991
STAT curr_items 12
STAT bytes 2048
END

STAT pid 1
STAT uptime 918273
 1.6.21
STAT curr_connections 12
STAT cmd_get 91823
 4021
STAT bytes 1048576
END

fpNotes: A different key-value service with its own STAT format is not reported; the memcached version line is required.
